7: אבל But [if] he said "It is incumbent upon me," no - Perhaps he will transgress and fail to fulfill [his vow], and thus it is established in the first chapter of Nedarim (Ned. 10a:1-2), for Rabbi Yehuda teaches "[best of all] is one who volunteers [a freewill offering] and pays (משלם)." (Note: This is a paraphrase of Nedarim, where the Gemara uses the term "מקיים" ("fulfills") rather than "משלם" ("pays").) Therefore, are "[everyone] may make valuations" and "[everyone] may vow" ab initio? No. For "[i]t is incumbent upon me" cannot be said [to be included] in it.
